hero.headline: How we hold ourselves accountable.
hero.sub: These standards apply to every player, coach, official, volunteer, parent, and supporter associated with New York Titans.

sections.title: Behavior
sections.oneLiner: Respect for opponents, officials, teammates, and the game in every interaction.

sections.title: Vilification
sections.oneLiner: No discrimination, harassment, or vilification on any grounds, ever.

sections.title: Substance policy
sections.oneLiner: Clear rules for alcohol, drugs, and any substance that affects performance or safety.

sections.oneLiner: What members owe to each other, the club, and the wider community.

sections.oneLiner: How we represent the club online — with respect, accuracy, and integrity.
